description: Large-margin linear classifier. Linear SVM finds a separating hyperplane in TF-IDF space; RBF SVM uses a kernel trick on dense TruncatedSVD-reduced features to capture nonlinear boundaries. C controls the margin/loss trade-off; gamma controls RBF kernel width.
why_tested: Linear SVM covered at mid-semester; RBF SVM added for end-semester to test whether a nonlinear kernel improves over the linear margin on dense-reduced text features.

input_features.linear: Sparse word unigram/bigram TF-IDF (max_features=60000, min_df=2, max_df=0.99, sublinear_tf=True).
input_features.rbf: Dense TruncatedSVD (100 components, training-fold fitted) of the same TF-IDF. SVD is a feature transform, not a classifier.

selection_rule: Max mean macro F1 on fixed group-respecting CV folds (development data only)
artifact_note: Linear and RBF are variants of the SVM family, not separate algorithms. Fitted development pipelines saved under models/svm/{linear,rbf}/artifacts/{protocol}/. SVD (rbf only) is saved as svd.joblib.
